verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes flag targeting, rollouts, and toggling but contains no documentation of streaming updates, real-time push, or specific polling intervals that would substantiate seconds-level propagation to SDKs; a community comment even notes Flagsmith does 'primarily server-side eval' rather than confirming fast client propagation. Missing for 10: documented real-time/streaming SDK update mechanism, polling interval specs, and evidence of kill-switch propagation latency.
